UPDATE jobs
            SET 
                status = CASE 
                    WHEN retry_count >= $2 THEN 'failed' 
                    ELSE 'active' 
                END,
                node_id = NULL,
                started_at = NULL,
                retry_count = retry_count + 1
            WHERE 
                status = 'processing' 
                AND (
                    (node_id IS NULL AND started_at < NOW() - make_interval(mins => $1))
                    OR node_id IN (SELECT id FROM nodes WHERE last_seen < NOW() - make_interval(mins => $1))
                )
